wrapper.definition: Something that is wrapped around something else as a cover or protection: a wrapping.

wreck.definition: Something or someone that has been ruined.

wrecked.definition: Form of wreck (participle past): To destroy violently; to cause severe damage to something, to a point where it no longer works, or is useless.

wretched.definition: Characterized by or feeling deep affliction or distress; very miserable.

wrist.definition: The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writers.definition: Form of writer (plural): A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrought.definition: Form of work (archaic participle past rare): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

wry.definition: Turned away, contorted (of the face or body).

xxx.definition: An abbreviation for kisses, usually placed at the end of a letter or text message, often alongside ooo (hugs).

yams.definition: Form of yam (plural): Any climbing vine of the genus Dioscorea in the Eastern and Western hemispheres, usually cultivated.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yawned.definition: Form of yawn (participle past): To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yell.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: Form of yield (participle past): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: Form of yield (gerund participle present): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yields.definition: Form of yield (indicative present singular third-person): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoke.definition: Form of yolk (misspelling): The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yoked.definition: Form of yoke (participle past): To join (several draught animals) together with a yoke; also, to fasten a yoke (on one or more draught animals) to pull a cart, plough, etc.; or to attach (a cart, plough, etc.) to a draug.

yokes.definition: Form of yoke (plural): Senses relating to a frame around the neck.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngest.definition: Form of young (superlative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: Form of youth (plural): The quality or state of being young.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealous.definition: Full of zeal; ardent, fervent; exhibiting enthusiasm or strong passion, particularly in matters of religion.

zealously.definition: Like, or in the manner of, a zealot; with great zeal or zealotry.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two fr.
